'''Corbro Stanch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] with [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armor]], Corbro Stanch worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he lived in the city of [[Mos Ila]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he worked as a bounty hunter trainer.

==Behind the scenes==
Corbro Stanch appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a trainer for the bounty hunter class on Tatooine.
